title: Data Broker Risk Calculator - Check Your Exposure Level
metaDescription: Calculate your personal data exposure risk across major data brokers. Get your privacy score and learn how to remove your information.
description: Assess how much of your personal information is likely exposed across data broker networks. This calculator evaluates your digital footprint and provides a personalized risk score with actionable steps to protect your privacy.

formula: const socialWeight = {minimal: 10, moderate: 25, heavy: 40, public: 60}; const accountsWeight = Math.min(inputs.onlineAccounts * 0.6, 40); const breachWeight = Math.min(inputs.dataBreaches * 8, 30); const recordsWeight = inputs.publicRecords ? 15: 0; const spamWeight = Math.min(inputs.phoneSpam * 1.2, 25); const optOutReduction = {none: 0, few: -5, many: -15, service: -25}; const baseScore = socialWeight[inputs.socialMediaActivity] + accountsWeight + breachWeight + recordsWeight + spamWeight; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseScore + optOutReduction[inputs.previousOptOuts])); const estimatedBrokers = Math.round((riskScore / 100) * 200 + 20); const riskLevel = riskScore <= 30 ? 'Low': riskScore <= 60 ? 'Moderate': riskScore <= 80 ? 'High': 'Critical'; return {riskScore: Math.round(riskScore), estimatedBrokers, riskLevel};

educational.methodology: This calculator assesses your data broker exposure risk by analyzing key factors that determine how much personal information is likely circulating among data brokers. It considers your digital activity patterns, account proliferation, breach history, public records, and current protection efforts to estimate your overall privacy risk.
tips: Start with major data brokers like WhitePages, Spokeo, and BeenVerified for manual opt-outs
Consider using a privacy-focused browser for sensitive searches to avoid creating new data trails
Data removal services like DeleteMe or Incogni can automate the opt-out process across 100+ brokers
Monitor spam calls/texts as they often indicate new data broker exposure
Regularly check haveibeenpwned.com for new breaches affecting your accounts
